_comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for the pooled-ratings CanonicalPoolKey word-lists (condition C5, tasks/pooled-ratings-plan.md). The Dart hint (lib/services/rating/canonical_pool_key.dart + lib/services/import/cache/recipe_text_normalizer.dart) and the TS server authority (functions/src/ratings/canonical-pool-key.ts) each hold native const copies for sync/no-runtime-IO reasons; drift-guard tests in BOTH languages assert those consts equal these lists IN ORDER (Dart: test/unit/services/rating/canonical_pool_key_wordlist_parity_test.dart; TS: functions/src/__tests__/pool-key-wordlist-parity.test.ts, run via `npm test`). A word added to one list but not the others fails CI here. Order matters: units/approx are joined into a regex alternation, so both languages must agree on order, not just membership. Do NOT reorder or edit without changing every consumer — the guard will catch you, which is the point.
